title: The Wand
subtitle: match: strict -- the whole stack, exactly
description: A stick named `Rubric Wand`, and the task asks for the whole stack
exactly: `match: strict` needs the carried stack to match the task's
data completely, not merely to carry the fields the task names.
The drowned parish used `match: fuzzy`, which asks a stack to have
the data the task names and forgives the rest. Strict forgives
nothing: the name has to be right and so does everything else,
which is the college's position on wands generally.
Anvil work, then, and no trading it away afterwards.
